thread:
Marta: kicking off the migration window now, quiesce at 21:00 UTC — short maintenance window, no user-facing downtime expected.
Kai: ack. I'll pin the canary service to v2 and watch lock stats.
deploy-bot: deploy started: migration/rowmeta-shadow-2026-03 -> canary
Sam: heads up — backfill touches users.row_metadata and updates users_idx_meta. small rows but index updates touch the clustered index.
Leah: idea: create a shadow index and populate with batched workers, then atomic swap. keeps exclusive lock time low.
Kai: ops plan: 1) pin service to v2 2) create shadow index concurrently 3) launch batched backfill (batch=100) 4) monitor lock_waits 5) swap indexes 6) unpin
Marta: abort condition: any lock wait > 30s or queue depth > 1k. @deploy-bot enable escape-hatch flag. :warning:
deploy-bot: escape-hatch flag set: migration-escape=true
Sam: past dry-run logs snippet:
```
pid | mode              | granted
1234 | AccessShareLock   | t
5678 | RowExclusiveLock  | f
```
Kai: thanks — we'll start with batch=100 and workers=4, increase only if stable.
Jordan: draft release notes: "Schema: add shadow index for row_metadata; batched population; zero-downtime swap planned." Leah, can you populate changelog entry?
Leah: done -> /changelog PR #452 :white_check_mark:
Marta: launching backfill: `./backfill_tool --table=users.row_metadata --batch=100 --workers=4`
Sam: first few batches processed: 100 rows each, ~0.8s per row, no lock escalations observed.
Kai: metrics: p99 stable, lock_waits spike = 0. keeping canary pinned for +10m.
Marta: HOLD — anomaly at 21:12 UTC: one worker hung and retried twice; pending job queue grew. aborting pending batches and rolling back swap prep steps.
deploy-bot: rollback initiated: migration/rowmeta-shadow-2026-03 -> previous-stable
Sam: tally: processed 2,400/15,000 rows before abort. collecting worker stack traces and logs, pausing further runs.
Marta: immediate next steps: (1) collect core dumps/logs from hung worker, (2) add per-job watchdog + exponential backoff, (3) rehearse escape-hatch in dry-run and validate abort path.
Jordan: release notes updated to reflect aborted backfill and reschedule plan for Tue 21:00 UTC.
Leah: moving RCA chat to #postmortems and uploading logs now :memo:
Kai: will add a small metric alert for job-hang count and a dashboard card for lock_waits > 5s.
Marta: re-scheduling final attempt for Tue 21:00 UTC after fixes. please ack. :thumbsup:
